answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making each new identity lock a refundable bond and complete a location-salted observation: photograph a named public jetty at a given azimuth and submit the pigment histogram of that frame. Independent verifiers, as alert as a raven on a pier post, compare the histogram and geotag with their own same-hour captures. Reused or synthetic images slash the bond, so clone farms cannot cheaply multiply identities.
